messages.subject: jointprior error
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

I am trying to use deal package for my research, but there is an error it
gives that I could not
understand. My execution sequence is as follows:

nw <- network(data.frame(d))
nw <- getnetwork(insert(nw,2,1,nocalc=TRUE))
prior <- jointprior(nw)
Error in s2.x %*% b.ylx : non-conformable arguments
In addition: Warning message:
number of items to replace is not a multiple of replacement length

d is a 1000x10 matrix composed of continuous data produced from a
multivariate
gaussian distribution. What is the mistake that I am doing here?

Thanks,

-- 
Mehmet
